title: Ministry of Justice investigating Russell Brand message from prison claiming he is not guilty
summary_full: PM’s spokesperson calls message, read out by convicted rapist’s wife on their YouTube channel, ‘clearly appalling’The Ministry of Justice has launched an investigation into whether Russell Brand has broken prison rules after the jailed comedian shared a message claiming he was not guilty of sexual offences just days after his conviction.Brand’s wife, Laura Brand, read a message from her rapist husband in a video uploaded to their YouTube channel in which he claimed: “I am not guilty of the offences I have been jailed for.” Continue reading...
